questions.question: Describe your experience testing APIs, web applications, widgets, and Unix batch jobs in the Amdocs environment. How did you design coverage across these different components?

You have supported ordering, CRM, billing, and payment-related applications. How would you approach validating an end-to-end business workflow where data passes through a web UI, API, database, and overnight batch process?

Tell us about a critical defect you found during release sanity testing or production certification. What made it difficult to identify, and how did you communicate it to the development and business teams?
What types of SQL queries have you written for test data creation, data analysis, or validation? Please walk through an example of how you used SQL to investigate a defect.
How have you validated XML responses or interface data against business requirements, particularly when testing APIs or integrations?
Describe your process for testing a production hotfix or patch package. What checks do you perform before certification, and how do you assess regression risk?

In your operations scheduling role, you managed critical billing runs and investigated batch-job failures. How did you triage a failed job using logs, determine the appropriate escalation path, and track resolution?

This role requires collaboration with developers, analysts, stakeholders, and vendors. Give an example of a calendar design review or requirements discussion where you identified a design gap or ambiguity and helped resolve it.
What was your role in creating automated test cases using QTP for the Amdocs iCare CRM module? How did you decide which regression scenarios were good candidates for automation?

This position supports Java/Spring Boot applications and requires close collaboration in code reviews, CI/CD, and release processes. Based on your QA and production-testing background, how would you partner with engineers to build quality checks and end-to-end traceability into a release pipeline?
